def predict2(g):
    bg,C=comps_of(g,8)
    infos=[{'cells':c,'n':len(c),'col':g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]],
            'cnt':{k:sum(1 for a,b in c if g[a][b]==k) for k in set(g[a][b] for a,b in c)}} for c in C]
    for d in infos:
        d['maj']=max(d['cnt'],key=lambda k:d['cnt'][k])
        d['shape']=norm(d['cells'])
    from collections import Counter
    ccomp=Counter(d['col'] for d in infos)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]; changes=[]
    # stray single cells
    strays=[(a,b,d['maj']) for d in infos if d['n']>1 for a,b in d['cells']
            if d['cnt'][g[a][b]]==1 and g[a][b]!=d['maj']]
    if strays:
        for x,y,c in strays: changes.append((x,y,c,'stray')); out[x][y]=c
        return out,changes,bg
    pairs=[]
    for i,a in enumerate(infos):
        for j in range(i+1,len(infos)):
            b=infos[j]
            if a['col']!=b['col'] and a['n']==b['n'] and a['shape'] in variants(b['shape']):
                pairs.append((a,b))
    if pairs:
        a,b=max(pairs,key=lambda p:p[0]['n'])
        cand=[d for d in infos if ccomp[d['col']]==1 and d['col'] not in (a['col'],b['col'])]
        tgt=max(cand,key=lambda d:d['n'])['col']
        tc=[d for d in infos if d['col']==tgt][0]
        bad=a if mindist(a['cells'],tc['cells'])>mindist(b['cells'],tc['cells']) else b
        for x,y in bad['cells']: changes.append((x,y,tgt,'pair')); out[x][y]=tgt
    return out,changes,bg

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    p,ch,bg=predict2(g)
    print(name,'OK' if p==go else 'FAIL', ch)

def predict4(g):
    U,bg=units(g)
    usl=[{'cells':c,'n':len(c),'col':g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]],'shape':norm(c)} for c in U]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]; ch=[]
    cu2=Counter(d['col'] for d in usl)
    singles2=[d for d in usl if cu2[d['col']]==1]
    T=max(singles2,key=lambda d:d['n'])['col']
    strays=[d for d in usl if d['n']==1 and cu2[d['col']]>1 and
            any(e['n']>1 and any(abs(a-x)<=1 and abs(b-y)<=1 for x,y in d['cells'] for a,b in e['cells']) for e in usl)]
    if strays:
        for d in strays:
            (x,y),=d['cells']; o[x][y]=T; ch.append((x,y,T,'stray'))
        return o,ch
    pairs=[]
    for i,a in enumerate(usl):
        for j in range(i+1,len(usl)):
            b=usl[j]
            if a['col']!=b['col'] and a['n']==b['n'] and a['shape'] in variants(b['shape']):

        tc=[d for d in usl if d['col']==T][0]
        bad=a if mindist(a['cells'],tc['cells'])>mindist(b['cells'],tc['cells']) else b
        for x,y in bad['cells']: o[x][y]=T; ch.append((x,y,T,'pair'))
    return o,ch

from collections import Counter, defaultdict

prog = '''def transform(grid):
    """task-01c596e5: among multi-cell 8-conn units congruent (translation/rotation)
    to another unit, the largest such pair is chosen; the member farthest from the
    target unit (largest unit of a single-unit color, excluding pair colors) is
    recolored to the target color. A stray size-1 unit (its color has >1 unit)
    orth/diag-adjacent to a larger unit of another color is absorbed instead."""
    from collections import Counter

    def norm(cells):
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        return tuple(sorted((r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells))

    def variants(shape):
        s = set()
        cur = list(shape)
        for _ in range(2):
            for _ in range(4):
                cur = [(c, -r) for r, c in cur]
                s.add(tuple(sorted(cur)))
            cur = [(r, -c) for r, c in cur]
            s.add(tuple(sorted(cur)))
        return s

    def mindist(u, t):
        return min(abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) for r1, c1 in u for r2, c2 in t)

    din = [row[:] for row in grid]
    R, C = len(din), len(din[0])
    bg = Counter(v for r in din for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set(); us = []
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if din[r][c] != bg and (r, c) not in seen:
                col = din[r][c]; st = [(r, c)]; seen.add((r, c)); comp = []
                while st:
                    a, b = st.pop(); comp.append((a, b))
                    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                            if dr == 0 and dc == 0:
                                continue
                            x, y = a + dr, b + dc
                            if 0 <= x < R and 0 <= y < C and (x, y) not in seen and din[x][y] == col:
                                seen.add((x, y)); st.append((x, y))
                us.append({'cells': comp, 'n': len(comp), 'col': col, 'shape': norm(comp)})
    cu = Counter(d['col'] for d in us)
    out = [r[:] for r in din]
    for d in us:
        if d['n'] == 1 and cu[d['col']] > 1:
            (x, y), = d['cells']
            adj = [e for e in us if e['n'] > 1 and any(abs(x - a) <= 1 and abs(y - b) <= 1 for a, b in e['cells'])]
            if adj:
                B = max(adj, key=lambda e: e['n'])
                out[x][y] = B['col']
                return out
    pairs = []
    for i, a in enumerate(us):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(us)):
            b = us[j]
            if a['n'] == b['n'] and a['n'] >= 2 and a['shape'] in variants(b['shape']):
                pairs.append((a, b))
    if not pairs:
        return out
    a, b = max(pairs, key=lambda p: p[0]['n'])
    cand = [d for d in us if cu[d['col']] == 1 and d['col'] not in (a['col'], b['col']) and d['n'] > 1]
    if not cand:
        return out
    tgt = max(cand, key=lambda d: d['n'])['col']
    tc = [d for d in us if d['col'] == tgt][0]
    da, db = mindist(a['cells'], tc['cells']), mindist(b['cells'], tc['cells'])
    bad = a if da > db else b
    for x, y in bad['cells']:
        out[x][y] = tgt
    return out
'''
